title: Charlottesville weather: 60 recent completed UTC days
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Hourly model estimates reformatted and clustered for teaching.
notes: Rows are hourly model-based estimates at a Charlottesville-area grid point, not direct station observations.
Precipitation is total precipitation in the preceding hour, including rain, showers and snow water equivalent.
Forecast days=0 excludes future forecast days; data are the past 60 completed UTC days.
Weather code, temperature and timestamps are context only and excluded from default clustering.
Cluster numbers are arbitrary; K=3 is a teaching choice and does not establish true weather categories.
All hours are included, so use clear rather than sunny unless restricting to daytime.
Time is Unix seconds in UTC; display via America/New_York to handle the November DST transition.
Dynamic refresh changes the sampling window; the bundled raw JSON/CSV preserve this exact snapshot.
